lineage.description: Drone orthomosaic imagery was acquired post-event over Thyolo district, Malawi following Tropical Storm Chalane. The aerial imagery was processed by GLOBHE using crowddroning methodology to create georeferenced orthomosaics documenting physical storm impacts on buildings and landscape features.
